groups.title: Groups
groups.benefit: Share tasks with family or team, plan together and assign responsibilities.

voiceInput.title: Voice input
voiceInput.benefit: Simply dictate tasks on the go instead of typing them.

aiAssist.title: AI assistance
aiAssist.benefit: Quick capture, suggestions and breaking down large tasks — with a larger monthly quota.

graphWrite.title: Dependencies
graphWrite.benefit: Link tasks and set their order in the graph yourself.

graphWeight.title: Weighted dependencies
graphWeight.benefit: Set how strongly a task depends on its predecessor.

locationReminders.title: Location reminders
locationReminders.benefit: Reminders that trigger when you are nearby.

mcpReadwrite.title: MCP write access
mcpReadwrite.benefit: Your own tools and assistants can not only read tasks but also create and change them.

mcpRead.title: MCP read access
mcpRead.benefit: Your own tools and assistants can read tasks and data via a personal API token.

feedback.title: Feedback and app support
feedback.benefit: Send feedback and support requests directly from the app — in every plan.

sync.title: Sync across all devices
sync.benefit: Your tasks always up to date on all your devices — in every plan.

knowledgeEntries.title: Knowledge entries
knowledgeEntries.benefit: Personal notes the AI takes into account when assigning new tasks to pillars.

fallback.title: More features
fallback.benefit: This feature is part of a larger plan.
